mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval through different mechanisms (fluoxetine via serotonergic effects and moxifloxacin via direct cardiac potassium channel inhibition), creating additive cardiotoxicity risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, obtain baseline ECG, monitor QTc interval, ensure normal electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), and consider alternative fluoroquinolone or antidepressant.
